description: PROP-E1-no-cohealth-touch (verification-architecture.md:31) maps to REQ-E1 with the assertion '= existing core-healthcheck plist still loaded after our install'. The behavioral spec only requires the script to 'leave it untouched'. There is no PROP mapped to verifying that the core-healthcheck plist's content/mtime is byte-identical before and after install, nor that no launchctl bootout was issued against ai.anicca.<slot>-core-healthcheck. The test as scoped is satisfied even if the script booted out and re-bootstrapped the core-healthcheck plist (since 'still loaded' would still be true). Add an explicit obligation: 'core-healthcheck.plist mtime + sha256 unchanged AND launchctl print shows uninterrupted PID for that label.'

evidence.snippet: PROP-E1-no-cohealth-touch | 1 | true | REQ-E1 (= existing core-healthcheck plist still loaded after our install)
